name: Asurion (device, appliance & tech protection - general)
notes: Researched from Asurion's public My Account landing page, Asurion Home+ page and FAQ, Asurion Appliance+ page and the Contact Us (call) page only; never signed in. Most Asurion protection (Verizon, AT&T, Cricket, Amazon, Lowe's, Walmart and other partner programs) is billed by the carrier or retailer, not by Asurion; each partner has its own Asurion phone number. This dossier models Asurion's direct subscriptions, Asurion Home+ and Asurion Appliance+, each 34.99 dollars a month plus tax, billed monthly to the credit or debit card on file and renewing until cancelled; there is no separate AutoPay enrollment, paper bill, guest payment or payment plan, so those are not_applicable (payment_arrangement is not_applicable with a note, which the server shows in place of the plan form). Because both plans cost the same, no plan list is modelled. Asurion bills cards only. My Account starts with a provider picker (Who's your provider?), which the fleet cannot express; the sign-in identifier and MFA are not observed and keep the family defaults. Home+ is cancelled by calling 844-529-2692 (prorated refund; claims can still be filed for 30 days after cancelling); Appliance+ (855-328-2847; no longer open to new enrollments, existing customers keep coverage) can be cancelled any time at no charge, channel not stated. Claim service fees (99, 49 or 0 dollars per approved Home+ claim depending on device) are paid at claim time and only described in help. Claim limits: 5,000 dollars per 12 months and 2,000 dollars per Home+ claim. Integrated 2026-10-09: billing.methods ['card']: no saved checking account; generated tasks use the saved Visa.

guest_pay.note: Asurion Home+ and Appliance+ are charged monthly to the card on file; there is no bill to pay without signing in.

autopay.note: Plans are billed monthly to your credit or debit card on file and renew until cancelled; there is nothing separate to enroll in.

autopay_cancel.note: To stop the monthly charge, cancel the plan.

paperless.note: Asurion charges the card on file; it does not mail paper bills.

payment_arrangement.note: Asurion Home+ and Appliance+ have no payment plans; the monthly fee is charged to your card on file, and you can cancel the plan at any time instead.

cancel_service.note: To cancel Asurion Home+, call 844-529-2692. You get a prorated refund and can still file a claim for 30 days after cancelling.

help.title: How you are billed
paragraphs: Asurion Home+ and Asurion Appliance+ each cost 34.99 dollars a month plus applicable taxes, billed monthly to the credit or debit card on file. The plan renews every month until you cancel. Asurion Appliance+ is no longer open to new enrollments; existing plans continue.
If your protection came with your phone carrier or a store (for example Verizon, AT&T, Cricket, Amazon or Lowe's), it is billed by that carrier or retailer, not directly by Asurion.

help.title: Asurion Home+ questions
paragraphs: Asurion Home+ is a service contract covering eligible home tech (TVs, computers, gaming systems, smart-home devices and more) plus 24/7 expert tech support. It is separate from, and does not extend, the manufacturer's warranty.
Tech support starts when you enroll; device protection starts on day 31, and failures before then are not covered.

Approved claims for accidental damage on portable devices have a service fee of 99, 49 or 0 dollars depending on the device. You can file unlimited claims up to 5,000 dollars per household every 12 months and 2,000 dollars per approved claim.
Claim updates arrive by email; you can also track a claim by calling 844-529-2692.

help.title: Cancel your Asurion plan
paragraphs: You can cancel Asurion Home+ at any time by calling 844-529-2692. You receive a prorated refund of your monthly fee, and you have 30 days after cancelling to file a claim.
Asurion Appliance+ can also be cancelled at any time at no extra charge, with a possible prorated refund under the terms and conditions; call 855-328-2847 with appliance questions.

help.title: Find the right Asurion phone number
paragraphs: Each carrier and retailer program has its own Asurion number. Asurion Home+: 844-529-2692. Asurion Appliance+: 855-328-2847. Verizon: 888-881-2622. AT&T: 888-562-8662. Amazon: 866-551-5924. Cricket: 855-309-8342. Lowe's: 888-775-6937.

Use the number for the store or carrier where you bought the plan. Be wary of emails or texts about a protection plan renewal that ask you to call a number in the message; check your plan in your own account or on your receipt instead.
